text: ■Next Mission\nMove from Menabra Plains to \nthe Wind Ark to start.
According to Kunon, Mare is worried about whether they can\nget help from Unda of the Resistance. Head to Nebbia Coast\nand look into it yourself!
You've reached the Nebbia Coast, which is close to Rana's\nterritory. Now try to find Unda and the Resistance soldiers!
When you try to help the Resistance soldiers you know,\nRondine, a bird monster, suddenly attacks!\nIt attacks everything it sees! Defeat it quickly!
